summary_en: UT Group authorized acquisition of up to 43 million shares (7.2% of outstanding shares) for up to 6 billion yen through market purchases from November 16, 2026 to March 31, 2027, to offset dilution from stock option exercises and support employee equity compensation.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
UT Group's board of directors authorized the acquisition of up to 43 million shares of the company's common stock for a maximum of 6 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 16, 2026 and March 31, 2027. This represents 7.2% of outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock) as of September 30, 2026, when 600,548,160 shares were outstanding.

The company will use the acquired shares to support its employee stock option program and employee equity compensation plan, offsetting the dilutive effect of stock option exercises. The acquisition aims to maintain and enhance shareholder value while preserving financial soundness. If stock options are not exercised, the company intends to consider using the treasury shares for other equity compensation purposes or cancellation.
